spans.s:
m. (-भः)
A spider.
E.
उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.

m. (-भः)
A spider.
E.
ऊर्ण wool, नाभि the navel, ड affix; also ऊर्णनाभि, the final being retained.

f. (-र्णा)
1 Wool, felt, the hair of camels, &c.
2 A circle of hair between the eye-brows.
E.
उर्णु to cover, ड affix; the word is properly ऊर्णा, q. v.

f. (-र्णा)
1 Wool, felt, &c. the hair of sheep, deer, camels, &c.
2 A circle of the hair between the eye-brows, considered as a token of greatness.
E.
ऊर्णु to cover, ड and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Wollen, made of wool.
E.
ऊर्णा and मयट् aff.

m. (-युः)
1 A woollen blanket.
2 A ram.
3 A spider.
E.
ऊर्णा wool, युस् aff.

r. 2nd cl. (ञ) ऊर्णुज (ऊर्णौति ऊर्णोति or ऊर्णुते)
To cover, hide, conceal, &c. with प्र prefixed प्रोर्णौति.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered.
E.
ऊर्णु and क्त aff.
